newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Nestle sales growth strong in early 1997.
newsitem.headline: Nestle sales growth strong in early 1997.

text.p: Swiss food group Nestle SA had double digit sales growth, on a Swiss franc basis, during the first two months of 1997 helped by a more favourable currency environment, Nestle financial officer Mario Corti said.

"Expressed in Swiss francs there is obviously very strong growth, in fact it was double-digit," Corti said about sales during the first two months of the year. The comments were made in an interview with Reuters Financial Television.
He also said that in view of exchange rate developments as compared to last year, it would be difficult to maintain these rates of sales growth.
